# Per-Genus Sensitivity Analysis

---

# 1. Setup & Load Data

```{r load-data}
rm(list=ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(metagenomeSeq)
library(MicrobiomeStat)
library(furrr)
library(ggrepel)

set.seed(2024)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FILE PATHS — Update these to match your directory structure
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

LINDA_PATH       <- "../EP395/artifact/linDA_Genus_raw.csv"
PROCESSED_DATA   <- "../EP395/export/ep395_processed_counts.RData"
BASELINE_TP      <- "Baseline 1"

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LOAD DATA
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Load linDA results
ep395_linda <- read_csv(LINDA_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(~ case_when(
    . %in% c("log2FoldChange", "log2fc") ~ "log2FC",
    . %in% c("std_error", "stderr", "SE") ~ "lfcSE",
    . %in% c("taxa") ~ "genus",
    TRUE ~ .
  )) %>%
  mutate(significant = padj < 0.05)

# Load normalized counts and metadata
load(PROCESSED_DATA)

# Extract baseline mean abundance per genus
bl_samples <- ep395_meta %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  filter(timepoint == BASELINE_TP) %>%
  pull(sample_id)

bl_counts <- ep395_counts_norm[bl_samples, ]
mean_abund_per_genus <- colMeans(bl_counts / rowSums(bl_counts))

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SUMMARY
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat(sprintf("═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n"))
cat(sprintf("Per-Genus Sensitivity Analysis for EP395\n"))
cat(sprintf("═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n"))
cat(sprintf("Total genera detected:      %d\n", length(mean_abund_per_genus)))
cat(sprintf("Significant DA genera:      %d\n", sum(ep395_linda$significant, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Baseline samples:           %d\n\n", nrow(bl_counts)))
```

---

# 2. Per-Genus Simulation Function

```{r sim-function}
simulate_power_for_genus <- function(
    n_subj,
    true_fc,
    genus_abund,
    baseline_genus_counts,
    depth = 50000L,
    n_sim = 100,
    alpha_fdr = 0.05,
    seed = NULL,
    ...
) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  

  baseline_genus_counts <- as.matrix(baseline_genus_counts)
  
  # Remove empty genera, just in case
  baseline_genus_counts <- baseline_genus_counts[
    rowSums(baseline_genus_counts, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Number of genera tested after filtering: this sets the FDR burden
  n_taxa <- nrow(baseline_genus_counts)
  
  if (n_taxa < 2) {
    stop("baseline_genus_counts must contain at least two genera.")
  }
  
  # Convert baseline table to relative abundance per sample
  sample_sums <- colSums(baseline_genus_counts, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep_samples <- sample_sums > 0
  
  baseline_genus_counts <- baseline_genus_counts[, keep_samples, drop = FALSE]
  sample_sums <- sample_sums[keep_samples]
  
  baseline_rel <- sweep(
    baseline_genus_counts,
    2,
    sample_sums,
    FUN = "/"
  )
  
  # Mean relative abundance per genus across baseline samples
  mean_genus_abund <- rowMeans(baseline_rel, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_genus_abund <- mean_genus_abund[
    is.finite(mean_genus_abund) & mean_genus_abund > 0
  ]
  
  if (length(mean_genus_abund) == 0) {
    stop("No positive genus relative abundances found.")
  }
  
  if (genus_abund <= 0 || genus_abund >= 1) {
    stop("genus_abund must be a relative abundance between 0 and 1.")
  }
  
  n_background <- n_taxa - 1
  p_abx_preview <- min(genus_abund * true_fc, 0.99)

  power_vec <- replicate(n_sim, {
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 1: Build synthetic count matrix
    # -----------------------------
    n_samples <- n_subj * 2
    
    counts <- matrix(
      0L,
      nrow = n_taxa,
      ncol = n_samples
    )
    
    rownames(counts) <- paste0("Genus", seq_len(n_taxa))
    colnames(counts) <- paste0("Sample", seq_len(n_samples))
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 2: Create paired metadata
    # -----------------------------
    meta_sim <- data.frame(
      sample_id  = colnames(counts),
      subject_id = factor(rep(paste0("Subj", seq_len(n_subj)), times = 2)),
      timepoint  = factor(
        rep(c("BL", "ABX"), each = n_subj),
        levels = c("BL", "ABX")
      ),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    rownames(meta_sim) <- meta_sim$sample_id
    
    bl_idx  <- which(meta_sim$timepoint == "BL")
    abx_idx <- which(meta_sim$timepoint == "ABX")
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 3: Simulate target genus
    # -----------------------------
    # Genus1 is the true changed genus.
    p_bl  <- genus_abund
    p_abx <- min(p_bl * true_fc, 0.99)
    
    counts[1, bl_idx] <- rbinom(
      n = n_subj,
      size = depth,
      prob = p_bl
    )
    
    counts[1, abx_idx] <- rbinom(
      n = n_subj,
      size = depth,
      prob = p_abx
    )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 4: Simulate background genera
    # -----------------------------
    # Background genera are sampled from the observed EP395 baseline
    # abundance distribution and are unchanged between BL and ABX.
    
    background_abund <- sample(
      mean_genus_abund,
      size = n_taxa - 1,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    for (i in 2:n_taxa) {
      p_i <- min(background_abund[i - 1], 0.99)
      
      counts[i, ] <- rbinom(
        n = n_samples,
        size = depth,
        prob = p_i
      )
    }
    
    # Add pseudocount to avoid zeros
    counts <- counts + 1L
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 5: Run LinDA
    # -----------------------------
    res <- tryCatch(
      {
           LinDA::linda(
              otu.tab = counts,       # taxa × samples
              meta    = meta_sim,     # samples × variables
              formula = "~ timepoint + (1 | subject_id)",
              alpha      = alpha_fdr,
              prev.cut   = 0,         # no prevalence filter in simulation
              lib.cut    = 1,         # no library size filter
              winsor.quan = 0.97      # standard winsorization
              # NO ... here — no extra params
            )

      },
      error = function(e) {
        message("LinDA error: ", e$message)
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
    
    if (is.null(res)) return(NA_real_)
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 6: Extract adjusted p-value for target genus
    # -----------------------------
    p_adj <- tryCatch(
      {
        res$output[["timepointABX"]]["Genus1", "padj"]
      },
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    )
    
    if (is.na(p_adj)) return(NA_real_)
    
    # -----------------------------
    # STEP 7: Detection yes/no
    # -----------------------------
    as.numeric(p_adj < alpha_fdr)
  })
  
  # Power = proportion of simulations where target genus was detected
  mean(power_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  
}
```

---

# 3. Per-Genus Simulation (Parallel Optimized)

```{r per-genus-sim-parallel, cache=TRUE}
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PRE-CALCULATE ONCE (not per genus)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Actual sample depths from EP395 baseline
real_sample_depths <- rowSums(ep395_counts_norm)   # per-sample depth
n_taxa_total <- nrow(ep395_counts_norm)            # number of genera

# Baseline relative abundance distribution per genus
baseline_rel_abund <- rowMeans(
  ep395_counts_norm / colSums(ep395_counts_norm)
)

# Total number of genera in baseline
n_taxa_total <- ncol(ep395_counts_norm)

cat(sprintf("Depth statistics from EP395 baseline:\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Min depth:    %.0f reads\n", min(real_sample_depths)))
cat(sprintf("  Median depth: %.0f reads\n", median(real_sample_depths)))
cat(sprintf("  Max depth:    %.0f reads\n", max(real_sample_depths)))
cat(sprintf("  Total genera: %d\n\n", n_taxa_total))


# Filter by minimum abundance (remove extremely rare genera)
MIN_ABUNDANCE <- 0.001  # 0.1% mean relative abundance threshold

all_genera <- ep395_linda %>% filter(visit == "v7") %>%
  pull(genus) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort() %>%
  # Keep only genera above abundance threshold
  {.[. %in% names(mean_abund_per_genus[mean_abund_per_genus >= MIN_ABUNDANCE])]}

n_below_threshold <- length(setdiff(
  ep395_linda %>% pull(genus) %>% unique(),
  all_genera
))

cat(sprintf("Running sensitivity simulations...\n"))
cat(sprintf("  Genera tested: %d\n", length(all_genera)))
cat(sprintf("  Excluded (< %.4f%% abundance): %d\n", MIN_ABUNDANCE*100, n_below_threshold))



# Setup parallel backend
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 5)

n_genera_total <- length(all_genera)
start_time <- Sys.time()

cat(sprintf("\n"))
cat(sprintf("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n"))
cat(sprintf("║ Per-Genus Sensitivity Simulation\n"))
cat(sprintf("║ Parameters: n_sim=30 | depth=20k | FC_grid=5 | Cores=20\n"))
cat(sprintf("║ Total genera to process: %d\n", n_genera_total))
cat(sprintf("║ Estimated time: 2-3 hours\n"))
cat(sprintf("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n"))

# Fold-change grid to test
fc_grid <- c(1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 5.0, 10.0)

# Per-genus sensitivity analysis (parallelized across genera)
per_genus_results <- future_map_dfr(all_genera, function(g) {

  
      # Calculate progress
    genus_idx <- which(all_genera == g)
    elapsed_secs <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "secs"))
    elapsed_mins <- elapsed_secs / 60
    
    # Estimate remaining time
    if (genus_idx > 1) {
      rate_per_genus <- elapsed_secs / (genus_idx - 1)  # seconds per genus
      remaining_genera <- n_genera_total - genus_idx
      est_remaining_secs <- remaining_genera * rate_per_genus
      est_remaining_mins <- est_remaining_secs / 60
    } else {
      est_remaining_mins <- NA
    }
    
    # Print progress
    pct_complete <- 100 * genus_idx / n_genera_total
    status_bar <- paste0(
      "[",
      paste0(rep("=", round(pct_complete / 5)), collapse = ""),
      paste0(rep(" ", 20 - round(pct_complete / 5)), collapse = ""),
      "]"
    )

    
  # Get genus abundance from baseline
  if (!g %in% names(mean_abund_per_genus)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  genus_mean_abund <- mean_abund_per_genus[g]
  # Get actual linDA result for this genus
 actual_result <- ep395_linda %>% 
  dplyr::filter(.data$genus == g)
 
  if (nrow(actual_result) == 0) return(NULL)

  # Simulate power across fold-change grid
  # Simulate power across fold-change grid
  power_curve <- map_dbl(
    fc_grid,
    ~ simulate_power_for_genus(
      n_subj                = 15,
      true_fc               = .x,
      genus_abund           = genus_mean_abund,
      baseline_genus_counts = t(ep395_counts_norm),
      depth = 50000L,
      n_sim                 = 50,
      alpha_fdr             = 0.05
      )
  )

    # Find MDFC (fold-change where power crosses 80%)
  mdfc <- NA_real_
  if (any(power_curve >= 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    idx <- min(which(power_curve >= 0.80))
    mdfc <- fc_grid[idx]
  }

  # Calculate post-hoc power for actual detected effect
  actual_fc <- 2 ^ abs(actual_result$log2FC[1])
  actual_power <- simulate_power_for_genus(
    n_subj      = 15,
    true_fc     = actual_fc,
      genus_abund           = genus_mean_abund,
      baseline_genus_counts = t(ep395_counts_norm),
      depth = 50000L,
      n_sim                 = 50,
      alpha_fdr             = 0.05
  )

  # Return results
  tibble(
    genus             = g,
    baseline_abund    = round(genus_mean_abund, 5),
    detected_log2FC   = round(actual_result$log2FC[1], 2),
    detected_FC       = round(actual_fc, 2),
    detected_padj     = round(actual_result$padj[1], 4),
    mdfc_80pct        = ifelse(is.na(mdfc), ">10", round(mdfc, 2)),
    post_hoc_power    = round(actual_power, 2),
    power_category    = case_when(
      actual_power >= 0.80 ~ "Well-powered (≥80%)",
      actual_power >= 0.60 ~ "Adequately powered (60-80%)",
      actual_power >= 0.40 ~ "Moderately powered (40-60%)",
      TRUE ~ "Under-powered (<40%)"
    )
  )
},
  .progress = TRUE,
  .options = furrr_options(
     packages = c("dplyr", "purrr", "tibble", "rlang"),
    globals = c(
      "mean_abund_per_genus",
      "ep395_linda",
      "ep395_counts_norm",
      "fc_grid",
      "simulate_power_for_genus",
      "all_genera","start_time","n_genera_total"
    )
  )
)

# Reset parallel plan
plan(sequential)

# Sort by power category and abundance
per_genus_results <- per_genus_results %>%
  mutate(power_category = factor(power_category,
                                 levels = c("Well-powered (≥80%)",
                                           "Adequately powered (60-80%)",
                                           "Moderately powered (40-60%)",
                                           "Under-powered (<40%)"))) %>%
  arrange(power_category, desc(baseline_abund))

write_tsv(per_genus_results, "../compare_diversities/analysis/tables/per_genus_sensitivity.tsv")

# Final summary
total_time <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins")
cat(sprintf("\n"))
cat(sprintf("╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\n"))
cat(sprintf("║ COMPLETE!\n"))
cat(sprintf("║ Total time: %.1f minutes\n", as.numeric(total_time)))
cat(sprintf("║ Genera processed: %d\n", nrow(per_genus_results)))
cat(sprintf("╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\n\n"))

```

# 4. Results Table

```{r results-table}
knitr::kable(
  per_genus_results %>%
    select(Genus = genus,
           "Baseline\nAbundance" = baseline_abund,
           "Detected\nLog₂FC" = detected_log2FC,
           "Detected\nFold-Change" = detected_FC,
           "FDR p-value" = detected_padj,
           "MDFC\n(80% power)" = mdfc_80pct,
           "Post-hoc\nPower" = post_hoc_power,
           "Power\nCategory" = power_category),
  caption = "Per-genus sensitivity analysis: detected effects vs. 80% power threshold"
)

write_tsv(per_genus_results, "../compare_diversities/analysis/tables/per_genus_sensitivity.tsv")
```


```{r}
# Diagnostic: which genera were lost?
sig_genera_input <- ep395_linda %>%
  filter(significant) %>%
  pull(genus) %>%
  unique()

sig_genera_output <- per_genus_results %>% pull(genus) %>% unique()

lost_genera <- setdiff(sig_genera_input, sig_genera_output)

cat(sprintf("═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n"))
cat(sprintf("DIAGNOSTIC: Genera filtering\n"))
cat(sprintf("═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n"))
cat(sprintf("Input (significant in linDA):   %d genera\n", length(sig_genera_input)))
cat(sprintf("Output (completed sim):         %d genera\n", length(sig_genera_output)))
cat(sprintf("Lost during simulation:         %d genera\n\n", length(lost_genera)))

if (length(lost_genera) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Genera that failed simulation:\n"))
  print(lost_genera)
  
  cat(sprintf("\nPossible causes:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("1. Genus not found in mean_abund_per_genus vector\n"))
  cat(sprintf("2. Multiple rows per genus (visit/timepoint issue)\n"))
  cat(sprintf("3. LinDA simulation crashed for that genus\n\n"))
  
  # Check which are in abundance data
  cat(sprintf("Checking if lost genera are in abundance data:\n"))
  in_abund <- lost_genera %in% names(mean_abund_per_genus)
  cat(sprintf("  In abundance data: %d / %d\n", sum(in_abund), length(lost_genera)))
  cat(sprintf("  Missing from abundance: %s\n", 
              paste(lost_genera[!in_abund], collapse = ", ")))
}
```

# 5. Visualization: Power vs Detected Effect Size

```{r viz-power}
per_genus_results <- read_tsv("../compare_diversities/analysis/tables/sensitivity_90000_200/per_genus_sensitivity_90000_200.tsv")

viz_df <- per_genus_results %>%
  mutate(genus_label = paste0(genus, "\n(abund=", baseline_abund, ")"),
         sig = (detected_padj<0.05) & (abs(detected_log2FC)>1))

p_power <- ggplot(viz_df, aes(x = detected_log2FC, y = post_hoc_power)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = sig, size = baseline_abund, shape = power_category),
             alpha = 0.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = c(-1.1,1.1), y = 0.3,angle = 90,
           label = c("LFC = -1","LFC = 1"), size = 3.2, hjust = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = min(viz_df$detected_log2FC), y = 0.82,
           label = "80% power threshold", size = 3.2, hjust = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_label_repel(aes(label = genus, color = sig), 
                   size = 2.8, box.padding = 0.3, alpha = 0.7,
                   force = 2, max.overlaps = 25, 
                   min.segment.length = 0, max.time = 10, max.iter = 1e5) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(viz_df$detected_log2FC), max(viz_df$detected_log2FC) + 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Well-powered (≥80%)" = 21,
               "Adequately powered (60-80%)" = 22,
               "Moderately powered (40-60%)" = 23,
               "Under-powered (<40%)" = 25),
    name = "Power Category"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#2ecc71", "FALSE" = "#95a5a6"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
    name = "Significance"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#2ecc71", "FALSE" = "#95a5a6"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Significant", "FALSE" = "Not significant"),
    name = "Significance"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Baseline rel. abundance", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(x = "Detected log fold-change",
       y = "Post-hoc statistical power") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        #legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.box.just = "left",
        legend.spacing.y = unit(-0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),       
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, stroke = 0.5, shape = 21), ncol = 1),
    size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey50", color = "black", stroke = 0.5, shape = 21), ncol = 1),
    color = "none",
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey50", size = 3, color = "black", stroke = 0.5), ncol = 1)
  )

p_power
ggsave("../compare_diversities/analysis/figures/per_genus_power.pdf",
       p_power, width = 12, height = 9)
```
